observations: Time column resizable(index !=0); earlier first-divider drag was not an eligible target. Current native attempts provider/model boundaries also did not visibly move.
Application set Row selected before this round. macOS adapter requires is_item_like, whose consumer role set excludes Row. Native selected absent does not prove application state missing.
Raw dropdown titles had no native labels. Named option content added to four SelectItem implementations plus custom provider MenuRow; existing Kit selection, search and callbacks retained.
Application ModalBody now carries named Dialog and modal flag. Native CUA shows names/roles but does not expose modal flag or prove screen-reader behavior.
